nodes.label: Icon Visual Identity Choice
nodes.rationale: The mark is a single flat-line document outline (rounded rectangle with a clipped top-right corner, i.e. a dog-eared page/PDF sheet) whose right edge is broken by an outward-pointing chevron. The chevron punching through the page border reads as 'data leaving the document' — the extraction/export action that names the product (ExpCore = Export Core, a PDF data-extraction tool). Rendered as a stroke-only monoline glyph on a flat dark-navy square with a light periwinkle accent so it stays legible at small Windows taskbar/installer sizes and matches the application's dark UI theme rather than a light-mode system tray look.

nodes.label: ExpCore 1.6.0: Windows PDF Coretax toolkit
nodes.rationale: Python 3.10+ desktop toolkit extracts withholding and input-tax PDFs to Excel and automatically renames Bupot PDFs. All processing stays local; PDFs and extraction results are not sent to the internet.

nodes.label: 151 local PDF regression samples
nodes.rationale: --pdf-samples reads contoh-pdf/JAN and contoh-pdf/FEB without changing PDFs. Expected JAN 75 rows and FEB 76 include nine formerly missed files whose tax rates were integers.

nodes.label: Bukti Potong 2026: Coretax BPPU extraction

nodes.label: Formatted Excel export

nodes.label: Official DJP text-PDF parser scope
nodes.rationale: Protected, corrupted, image-only scanned PDFs and nonstandard layouts may fail. BPPU Coretax and pre-Coretax BPBS have distinct parsers.

nodes.label: Recursive PDF subfolder scanning
nodes.rationale: Combines selected folder and descendants into one output in the selected folder; Folder Sumber records each PDF's original location.

nodes.label: Rename preview and application audit CSV
nodes.rationale: Log_Penamaan_Bupot_Pratinjau_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv and Log_Penamaan_Bupot_Penerapan_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv preserve NAMA_PENERIMA and NAMA_PEMOTONG for auditing.

nodes.label: Penamaan Otomatis Bupot
nodes.rationale: Produces Nama Pemotong (C.3) - Nomor Bukti - Masa Pajak - Sifat - Status.pdf. Preview completion unlocks apply; confirmation precedes a fresh scan of current folder contents.

nodes.label: Required-field validation and collision-safe filenames
nodes.rationale: Missing required data skips a PDF. Existing filenames are never overwritten; numeric suffixes such as (2) resolve collisions.

nodes.label: Four-tool desktop workspace
nodes.rationale: Persistent navigation, folder picker/text input, progress, activity log and direct result access. Background processing locks folder changes and process buttons against concurrent jobs. Scrollable content retains visible bottom actions and routes log-boundary wheel events to the page.

nodes.label: build_release.py consistent Nuitka release build
nodes.rationale: Produces ExpCore.dist/. Compiling pandas and numpy takes substantial time. First build downloads Nuitka support tools to the user cache with noninteractive consent; subsequent builds reuse cached tools.

nodes.label: expcore_updates.py GitHub release checks and per-user cache
nodes.norm_label: expcore_updates.py github release checks and per-user cache

nodes.label: ExpCore.iss installer configuration
nodes.rationale: Inno compilation produces ExpCore/ExpCore-Setup-1.6.0.exe, named from VERSION. Rejects absent ExpCore.dist/VERSION or a mismatch with source VERSION; rebuilding after a version change is required.

nodes.label: Nuitka standalone executable build
nodes.rationale: Nuitka bundles dependencies from its running interpreter rather than the project directory; missing modules may produce warnings while still creating an executable that crashes at startup.

nodes.label: test_expcore_ui.py desktop UI tests
nodes.rationale: Requires Tcl/Tk; leaves user PDFs unchanged. Covers layout, workers and interaction at scale 1, 1.25 and 1.5, plus update banner/download controls, closing with active worker and control recovery after errors.

nodes.label: test_expcore_updates.py offline mocked-GitHub tests
nodes.rationale: Covers version comparisons, stable releases, installer readiness, official URLs, caching, throttling, malformed/oversized responses, timeout, TLS, HTTP 404/403/429/503 and cache persistence failure.

nodes.label: ExpCore.dist standalone distribution
nodes.rationale: Before installer compilation verify pdfplumber, pdfminer, pandas, numpy and customtkinter are present. Missing packages indicate a wrong build interpreter; removing ExpCore.build does not fix that.

nodes.label: VERSION single source: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
nodes.rationale: Supplies app version, executable metadata and installer version. build_release.py bundles VERSION automatically; the dist copy must not be edited manually.

nodes.label: Diagnosing silent standalone startup crashes
nodes.rationale: Console-disabled builds hide startup errors; redirect stderr/stdout to inspect them, or temporarily force console mode for a trial build. Missing pdfplumber typically indicates the wrong Nuitka interpreter. A working source launch with failing build isolates packaging issues.

nodes.label: Dependency import preflight
nodes.rationale: Verify customtkinter, pdfplumber, pandas and openpyxl imports before source launch; include nuitka before build to prevent incomplete dependency bundles.

nodes.label: Explicit .venv/Scripts/python.exe invocation
nodes.rationale: Avoids PATH selecting global, Microsoft Store, conda or another tool's interpreter. Forward slash paths work in PowerShell and Git Bash without backslash escaping errors.

nodes.label: Manual upgrade required from ExpCore 1.5 and earlier
nodes.rationale: Users install 1.6.0 manually once because automated notifications require a version already containing the update checker.
nodes.norm_label: manual upgrade required from expcore 1.5 and earlier

nodes.label: Draft-to-stable release publication workflow
nodes.rationale: Change VERSION, run parser/update/UI tests, build and open executable, compile installer, create draft with exact v+VERSION tag, upload versioned setup and notes, verify artifacts, publish stable and mark latest. Legacy ExpCore.exe assets remain supported; pushing a commit or tag alone does not trigger notifications.

nodes.label: Stable official release and ready-installer validation
nodes.rationale: Drafts, prereleases, invalid tags, links outside the official repository and incomplete installer uploads never generate download offers.
nodes.norm_label: stable official release and ready-installer validation

nodes.label: Update retry throttling and backoff
nodes.rationale: Connection failures delay retry 15 minutes. GitHub rate limits follow the server wait bounded between 60 seconds and 24 hours.

nodes.label: Unduh update / Nanti nonblocking update banner
nodes.rationale: Download opens the official release page; user downloads and runs the installer. Nanti hides the banner for the session and a manual check can show it again.
nodes.norm_label: unduh update / nanti nonblocking update banner

nodes.label: 24-hour per-user update cache
nodes.rationale: Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%/ExpCore/update-check.json. Manual Periksa update bypasses cache after 60 seconds.

nodes.label: GitHub stable release update checker
nodes.rationale: Checks iyansanjaya/ExpCore after UI startup while PDF work/navigation continue. Offers a newer version only when its installer is ready.

nodes.label: HTTPS public metadata only; no document uploads or GitHub tokens
nodes.rationale: Requests exclude PDFs, document content, filenames and user folder paths. Automatic network failures cause no dialogs; manual checks explain failure and offline application use continues.
nodes.norm_label: https public metadata only; no document uploads or github tokens

nodes.label: test_expcore.py
nodes.rationale: Tests parsing, renaming, exports for three modules, subfolders and corrupted-PDF batch continuation. --pdf-samples checks 151 local PDFs without changing documents.

nodes.label: test_expcore_ui.py
nodes.rationale: Tests real Tk wheel events, scrollbar clicks, keyboard, nested logs, resize both directions, pinned actions, worker isolation, error recovery, results and confirmations at scales 1.0, 1.25 and 1.5.

nodes.label: ExpCore desktop workspace
nodes.rationale: Editorial Awesomic-inspired zinc surfaces, clear hierarchy, rounded cards and orange markers make document tools and actions discoverable.

nodes.label: 8 September 2026 scroll repair verification
nodes.rationale: Two rounds at 100%, 125% and 150% passed all six runs over five pages. Windows inspection confirmed all home cards and buttons and Pajak Masukan log-edge scrolling with pinned actions. New tests had first failed on empty home scrollregion and unforwarded log-margin wheel events.

nodes.label: VERSION single source for UI and installer
nodes.norm_label: version single source for ui and installer

nodes.label: Additive responsive bind(..., add="+") handlers
nodes.rationale: Preserves CustomTkinter scrollregion updates instead of overwriting its existing handlers.

nodes.label: Overwrite confirmation and batch completion safeguards
nodes.rationale: Existing exports require confirmation. Closing during work waits until results and logs are written. Unreadable PDFs are logged and skipped so the batch continues.
nodes.norm_label: overwrite confirmation and batch completion safeguards

nodes.label: 44 px folder field and picker; 14 px radius; 2 px border
nodes.rationale: Polygon canvas rendering prevents font-glyph corner seams at fractional DPI. Focus color changes preserve control size. BPPU helper text describes the active tool.
nodes.norm_label: 44 px folder field and picker; 14 px radius; 2 px border

nodes.label: Inline results, open Excel/CSV and copy log
nodes.rationale: Changing the folder invalidates prior result links and rename preview status.
nodes.norm_label: inline results, open excel/csv and copy log

nodes.label: Keyboard navigation and shortcuts
nodes.rationale: Tab/Shift+Tab moves focus; Enter/Space activates buttons; Ctrl+O selects folder; Alt+0 opens home; Alt+1–4 opens tools; Page Up/Down scrolls outside text editors.

nodes.label: Nested log and page wheel routing
nodes.rationale: Long logs scroll independently; empty logs and log boundaries forward the wheel to the page. One gesture scrolls one area, including cards, labels, buttons, folder fields and log margins.
nodes.norm_label: nested log and page wheel routing

nodes.label: Persistent sidebar and per-tool session state
nodes.rationale: Each of four tools retains its folder, activity and results while navigation remains active.
nodes.norm_label: persistent sidebar and per-tool session state

nodes.label: Completed rename preview gates application
nodes.rationale: Confirmation explains that application rescans current folder conditions.

nodes.label: Responsive scrollable content and pinned primary actions
nodes.rationale: Short windows scroll content while processing controls stay at the bottom. Narrow widths stack the introduction, compact the home guide, and collapse cards to one column. Initial size adapts to screen/DPI, minimum 960 × 620 logical px.
nodes.norm_label: responsive scrollable content and pinned primary actions

nodes.label: Native Segoe UI font
nodes.rationale: Avoids font downloads and remains available offline. Home headings 34–40 px, tool headings 36 px, card headings 20 px, interface text 12–14 px.

nodes.label: Background public GitHub release check
nodes.rationale: Updates use a separate worker with no document uploads or account tokens. A dismissible nonblocking banner opens the official release; automatic failures stay quiet and manual outcomes use dialogs.

nodes.label: Visual tokens: zinc, white, black, orange #ff5a00
nodes.rationale: Colors live once in Workspace.C. White cards have thin borders without shadows; text accompanies status so color is not the only differentiator. Orange badges use dark text for small-text contrast.
nodes.norm_label: visual tokens: zinc, white, black, orange #ff5a00

nodes.label: Worker queue to Tk thread
nodes.rationale: Background work sends progress and logs through a queue to Tk. Folder and processing controls lock for one active job while navigation stays usable.
